description: This file defines the `WriteRequestBatch` class, which manages batching of DynamoDB put and delete requests for efficient bulk operations, including queue management, auto-flushing, and handling unprocessed items.

classes.name: WriteRequestBatch
classes.description: Manages batching and efficient sending of DynamoDB Put and Delete requests with support for auto-flushing and retrying unprocessed items.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the batch with the client and configuration options, validates batch size and callbacks.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Adds a put request to the batch queue.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Adds a delete request to the batch queue.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Sends queued requests as BatchWriteItem commands, handles unprocessed items, and can repeat until the queue is empty if specified.

methods.name: prepareCommands
methods.description: Creates BatchWriteItem commands from the current queue.

methods.name: retryUnprocessed
methods.description: Re-queues unprocessed requests received from DynamoDB responses for retries.

methods.name: autoFlush
methods.description: Automatically flushes the queue if the autoflush setting is enabled and the threshold is reached.

methods.name: determineTable
methods.description: Determines the table name for a request, either from parameter or batch configuration.
